summary: Full E2E testing of redesigned /s/maestre page (admin side). All 14 feature points in the review request verified successfully: admin login, two-section modal (Dati anagrafici + Credenziali di accesso), info banner mentioning email as username, pre-populated readable password at open, lowercase forcing on email, Show/Hide + Generate buttons, sticky footer visible at 1920x1080 and 390x844, password validation blocks short/empty pwd, create flow shows success panel with copy-email + copy-pwd buttons, new teacher card exposes 'Nome utente per il login' with email, E2E login as the newly created teacher works, edit with empty pwd preserves old password, edit with new pwd rotates credentials (new works, old rejected), delete removes the teacher. No backend testing performed because backend was unchanged per request. Test teacher was created and cleaned up (deleted) at the end.
critical_code_review_comments: Teachers.jsx line 42-45: password validation runs only in CREATE branch; a toast is shown via sonner but the native HTML `required` + `minLength=6` already block submission. The custom toast message is thus only reachable programmatically, not through normal user interaction. Not a bug, but the duplicated validation is minor dead code when the field has required/minLength set.

Teachers.jsx: PATCH payload includes empty-string password in edit mode when user leaves it blank. Backend behaviour (confirmed by E2E test) correctly ignores empty password and preserves the hash — but it would be cleaner to omit `password` from the payload when falsy to avoid relying on backend truthiness check.
Modal is defined inline in Teachers.jsx (lines 218-235); if other pages adopt the same sticky-footer pattern, extracting a shared Modal primitive would reduce duplication.
